narrative_purpose: Show the ordinary outcome — a world of Earth's size whose crust never broke — so the reader sees that plate tectonics is the exception rather than the default.
subject: A planet's surface seen from low orbit, curving away to a hazy limb across the top of the frame. The visible crust is one continuous unbroken sheet: nowhere is there a long linear ridge, a linear trench, or any straight boundary crossing it. Instead the surface carries about eight wide circular structures of varying size, each a low ring or coronet of concentric ridges with a slightly sunken centre, scattered across the plains. One very large low shield volcano swells gently in the middle distance, broad and flat with a small summit depression. The plains between them are dry, cracked into irregular polygonal patterns, and dusty. Thick pale haze lies over everything, thinning toward the limb where a dense atmosphere glows faintly.
scene: A dry, single-shelled rocky planet seen from low orbit through thick haze.
camera: High oblique orbital view looking down and forward across the surface to the curved limb.
light: Flat diffuse illumination heavily scattered by the thick atmosphere, so shadows are soft and long-wavelength; no bioluminescence anywhere; the limb carrying a faint pale amber atmospheric glow.
palette: Dull stone-grey and desaturated buff plains, void-indigo in the ring depressions and cracks, cool teal-indigo haze, restrained pale amber only at the atmospheric limb.
style: Painterly planetary surface plate, dry matte rock texture, heavy atmospheric scattering, naturalist rather than dramatic.
detail_level: Cracked plain texture and concentric ring structures crisp in the near and middle ground; everything progressively dissolving into haze toward the limb.
composition: The limb across the upper quarter; the great shield volcano as a broad low swell right of centre in the middle distance; circular ring structures scattered irregularly across the plains with deliberately no linear alignment anywhere.
consistency_notes: This is explicitly NOT Pandora — it is the dry one-plate comparison world, so it must carry no bioluminescence and no water. The absence of any linear boundary is the entire point of the image and must be unmistakable.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no diagram lines, no arrows, no linear ridges or trenches, no oceans, no vegetation, no glowing plants, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon style
